title: Thick points of log-correlated Gaussian fields do not depend on the mollifier
summary: The log-correlated Gaussian field (LGF) on $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d \geq 2$) is a centered Gaussian random tempered distribution, defined modulo additive constants, whose covariance kernel is $\log(1/|x-y|)$. In two dimensions, the LGF coincides with the whole-plane Gaussian Free Field (GFF). Because the field is a distribution, studying its pointwise behavior requires regularization via convolution with a mollifier.
